principles: Known undesirable information may eliminate; missing information remains unknown and must not be treated as a negative.
Canonical field IDs describe meaning, not display units or language.
Canonical enum values are immutable language-neutral identifiers. Human-readable labels live in locale catalogs.
Measurements are stored in canonical internal units declared by the field registry; source values and source units are preserved separately.
US gallons and Imperial gallons are never conflated; unresolved 'gallon' sources remain unresolved.
Objective facts, normalized classifications, derived characteristics and editorial judgments are distinct data classes.
Power, sail and motorsailer models share one canonical architecture; non-applicable subsystem fields are explicitly Not Applicable rather than Unknown.
Primary propulsion mode is separate from mechanical propulsion so sailboats and motorsailers are represented correctly.
Preference matching consumes canonical facts and derived characteristics; preference questions do not automatically create new factual fields.
Every structured canonical field that may be corrected is individually correctable.
Canonical model values and source/evidence assertions are stored separately.

Production phases/generations are separate scoped records under one canonical model. Construction or dimensional changes do not create duplicate models unless builder/market identity changed or continuity would materially mislead.
